about_the_game:
In Divine Weapons Unleashed, players take on the role of a character who enters a dream while sleeping, where they must face monsters invading the dreamworld.

Players choose weapon enhancement paths with the mouse, challenging monsters across 20+ levels. Each enhancement activates random skills. By defeating monsters, players earn experience points. With each level up, they can select new skills or strengthen existing ones to fend off monster attacks.

The game features a rich reward system, including online duration rewards, quest rewards, and level-clearing rewards. Equipment, gems, and other items are available to boost the player's combat power. Players can also spend diamonds to open treasure chests, purchase upgrade items, and unlock additional characters and pets.
